groupingDescription.description: The description of the grouping schedule this classification belongs to (e.g., "Standard Balance Sheet", "Cash Flow Statement").

codeKey.description: The unique identifier for the grouping code.

subcodeKey.description: The unique identifier for the grouping subcode.

codeDescription.description: The description of the grouping code (e.g., "Assets", "Liabilities", "Equity").

subcodeDescription.description: The description of the grouping subcode (e.g., "Current Assets", "Non-Current Assets").

bindingName.description: The binding name used to map this grouping to a specific column in the view.

value.description: The combined value representing the code and subcode assignment (e.g., "A-CA" for Assets - Current Assets).

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalT.description: Represents a journal entry (JE) distribution detail associated with trial balance accounts. Contains complete information about a single JE line item including debits, credits, account details, and tax classifications.

jeDistributionKey.description: The unique identifier for this journal entry distribution line.

accountKey.description: The account key that this JE distribution affects.

debit.description: The debit amount for this distribution line. Zero if this is a credit entry.

credit.description: The credit amount for this distribution line. Zero if this is a debit entry.

accountType.description: The type of account this distribution affects (e.g., "Asset", "Liability", "Expense").

jeKey.description: The unique identifier for the parent journal entry.

trialBalanceKey.description: The trial balance key this JE belongs to.

tbPeriodKey.description: The trial balance period key for the period this JE is recorded in.

description.description: Description or explanation of this journal entry line.

reference.description: Reference number or code for this journal entry.

account.description: The account number this distribution affects.

accountDescription.description: The description of the account this distribution affects.

wpReference.description: Workpaper reference associated with this JE distribution.

workpaperKey.description: The workpaper key if this JE is linked to a workpaper.

diffType.description: The type of difference or adjustment this JE represents.

taxCode.description: Tax code assignment for this JE distribution.

taxSubCode.description: Tax subcode for finer tax classification.

m3Code.description: M3 code assignment for Schedule M-3 reconciliation.

m3Subcode.description: M3 subcode for finer M3 classification.

misstatementType.description: Type of misstatement this JE corrects (if applicable).

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalT.description: Request model for retrieving paginated trial balance account data for a specific engagement and view configuration.

engagementId.description: The Id of the Engagement. Must be greater than zero.

viewConfigKey.description: The Id of the viewConfig. Must be greater than zero.

pageIndex.description: Zero-based page index for pagination. Use 0 for the first page, 1 for the second page, etc.

pageSize.description: Number of records to return per page. Maximum recommended value is 1000. Default is 1000.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalT.description: Response model representing a trial balance view configuration with its column definitions. Views define which columns appear when retrieving trial balance data.

viewName.description: The name of the view configuration (e.g., "Standard View", "Tax View", "Custom View 1").

columnInfo.description: List of column definitions that specify which columns are included in this view and their configuration details.

viewConfigKey.description: The unique identifier for this view configuration. Use this value when requesting trial balance grid data.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalT.description: Defines a single column in a trial balance view configuration, including its binding name, display name, type, and associated grouping schedule.

bindingName.description: The internal binding name used to map this column to data properties (e.g., "AccountNumber", "Description", "Balance1").

columnType.description: The type of data this column contains (e.g., Text, Number, Date, Balance, GroupingCode).

columnName.description: The display name for this column as shown to users (e.g., "Account Number", "Description", "Current Year Balance").

groupingScheduleKey.description: The grouping schedule key associated with this column if the column represents grouping codes. Zero if not applicable.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsTaxCodeRe.description: Response model containing tax code information including codes, subcodes, vendor details, and entity type associations. Used for assigning tax classifications to trial balance accounts.

taxCodeGroupingKey.description: The unique identifier for the tax code grouping that this tax code belongs to.

taxCodeKey.description: The unique identifier for this tax code.

code.description: The short code representing this tax code (e.g., "1", "2a", "10").

m3Type.description: Indicates whether this is an M3 type tax code. M3 codes are used for Schedule M-3 tax reconciliation.

description.description: The description of what this tax code represents (e.g., "Gross receipts or sales", "Cost of goods sold").

vendorId.description: The vendor identifier (e.g., 1040, 1065, 1120) indicating which tax form this code applies to.

entityTypeId.description: The entity type identifier (e.g., 1 for Individual, 2 for Partnership, 3 for Corporation).

taxYear.description: The tax year that this code configuration applies to.

subCodes.description: List of subcodes available under this tax code. Subcodes provide finer classification within a tax code.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsTaxSubcod.description: Represents a tax subcode providing finer classification within a parent tax code. Subcodes allow for more granular categorization of account tax treatments.

taxCodeKey.description: The unique identifier of the parent tax code that this subcode belongs to.

taxCodeSubcodeKey.description: The unique identifier for this tax subcode.

code.description: The short code representing this tax subcode (e.g., "a", "b", "1").

description.description: The description of what this tax subcode represents, providing additional detail beyond the parent tax code.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalT.description: Response model containing tax vendor and entity type definitions with their associated tax code groupings. Used to understand available tax classifications for different tax vendors (1040, 1065, 1120, etc.) and entity types.

taxVendorKey.description: The tax code vendor enumeration value (e.g., 1040 for Individual, 1065 for Partnership, 1120 for Corporation).

taxVendorName.description: The human-readable name of the tax vendor (e.g., "Individual 1040", "Partnership 1065", "Corporation 1120").

taxGroupings.description: List of tax code groupings available for this vendor and entity type combination. Each grouping represents a category of tax codes.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalT.description: Represents a tax code grouping category within a tax vendor and entity type combination. Groupings organize tax codes into logical categories (e.g., Income, Deductions, Credits).

taxCodeGroupingKey.description: The unique identifier for this tax code grouping.

description.description: The description of the tax code grouping category (e.g., "Income", "Deductions", "Adjustments").

entityType.description: The entity type identifier associated with this grouping (e.g., individual, partnership, corporation).

m3Grouping.description: Indicates whether this is an M3 grouping. M3 groupings are used for Schedule M-3 tax reconciliation reporting.

displayIndex.description: Optional display order index for sorting groupings in UI elements. Lower numbers appear first.

jeKey.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry. This is the primary key used to reference this specific JE.

trialBalanceKey.description: Identifier for the trial balance that this journal entry belongs to. Links the JE to a specific TB.

trialBalancePeriodKey.description: Identifier for the trial balance period (e.g., fiscal year-end, quarter-end). Required field.

reference.description: User-defined reference code or number for this journal entry (e.g., "JE-001", "ADJ-2024-15"). Required field.

jeType.description: Type classification of the journal entry (e.g., "Standard", "Adjusting", "Reclassification", "Elimination").

description.description: General description or narrative explaining the purpose and nature of this journal entry.

accounts.description: Comma-separated list or summary of account numbers affected by this journal entry.

amount.description: Total amount of the journal entry. Typically equals the debit or credit side (both should be equal in a balanced entry).

workpaperRef.description: Reference to the related workpaper document (e.g., "A-1", "B-3") where the supporting documentation exists.

jeDetails.description: List of detailed line items (debits and credits) that make up this journal entry. Each detail represents one account affected.

journalEntryRollForwardType.description: Classification for rollforward behavior (e.g., "Manual", "Automatic", "NoRollForward"). Indicates how this JE should be handled during period rollovers.

misstatementType.description: Type of misstatement this journal entry addresses (e.g., "Material", "Immaterial", "None"). Used for audit purposes.

diffType.description: Difference type classification (e.g., "Permanent", "Timing", "None"). Indicates the nature of the adjustment.

jeWorkpaper.description: Associated workpaper information containing detailed supporting documentation for this journal entry. Null if no workpaper is attached.

workpaperKey.description: Unique identifier linking this journal entry to a specific workpaper. Null if no workpaper is associated.

debitTotal.description: Sum of all debit amounts in the journal entry detail lines. Should equal CreditTotal in a balanced entry.

creditTotal.description: Sum of all credit amounts in the journal entry detail lines. Should equal DebitTotal in a balanced entry.

isLockedOrFinalized.description: Indicates whether this journal entry is locked for editing or the engagement is finalized. True means the JE cannot be modified.

id.description: Unique identifier for the workpaper associated with this journal entry.

reference.description: Reference code or identifier for the workpaper (e.g., workpaper index like "A-1", "B-3").

description.description: Descriptive text explaining the purpose or content of the workpaper.

jeReference.description: Journal entry reference code that links this workpaper to a specific JE.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalJ.description: Request model for deleting one or more journal entries. Supports bulk deletion by accepting multiple JE keys in a single operation.

engagementId.description: Unique identifier of the engagement (binder) containing the journal entries to delete. All JE keys must belong to this engagement.

jeKeys.description: List of journal entry keys (IDs) to permanently delete. Can contain a single key or multiple keys for bulk deletion. All entries must exist in the specified engagement.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalJ.description: Request model for journal entry save and update operations. Contains the engagement context and the journal entry details to save or update.

currentJe.description: The journal entry data to save or update, including all line items, classifications, and metadata.

engagementId.description: Unique identifier of the engagement (binder) where this journal entry will be saved. Must correspond to an existing, non-finalized engagement.

allOf.description: Complete journal entry model for save and update operations. Extends the base model with classification fields for JE type, roll forward behavior, and misstatement categorization.

jeType.description: Classification of the journal entry type. Valid values: "Standard", "Adjusting", "Reclassification", "Elimination". Determines how the entry is categorized in financial reports.

journalEntryRollForwardType.description: Specifies how this journal entry should be handled during engagement roll forward to the next period. Valid values: "Manual" (review required), "Automatic" (auto-carry forward), "None" (one-time entry).

misstatementType.description: Type of misstatement this journal entry corrects or represents. Valid values: "Immaterial", "Material", "NotApplicable". Used for audit materiality assessment.

diffType.description: Classification of the difference being corrected. Valid values: "Timing" (reverses next period), "Permanent" (does not reverse), "NotApplicable". Helps determine audit adjustments.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalJ.description: Base model containing common properties for journal entry operations (save, update). Includes reference information, description, and line item details.

reference.description: Unique reference number or identifier for the journal entry. Used for tracking and cross-referencing entries.

description.description: Detailed description explaining the purpose and nature of this journal entry. Helps auditors understand the adjustment.

workpaperRef.description: Reference to the workpaper documenting this journal entry. Links the JE to supporting documentation in the binder.

jeDetails.description: Collection of debit and credit line items that make up this journal entry. Must contain at least two items and debits must equal credits.

jeKey.description: Unique identifier (primary key) of the journal entry in the system. Required for update and delete operations. Auto-generated on save.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalJ.description: Represents a single line item (debit or credit) within a journal entry. Each JE detail corresponds to one account being debited or credited.

accountKey.description: Unique identifier of the trial balance account to debit or credit. Must correspond to an existing account in the engagement's trial balance.

credit.description: Credit amount for this line item. Set to 0 if this is a debit-only entry. Credits increase liability, equity, and revenue accounts.

debit.description: Debit amount for this line item. Set to 0 if this is a credit-only entry. Debits increase asset and expense accounts.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description: Request DTO for uploading a document chunk as part of a chunked file upload process, enabling large file uploads by splitting into smaller parts.

documentType.description: The type of document being uploaded (e.g., "Excel", "Word", "PDF").

fileName.description: The complete original file name of the document being uploaded.

fileNamePart.description: The file name for this specific chunk part.

chunk.description: The base64-encoded binary data for this chunk of the file.

offset.description: The byte offset position where this chunk starts in the complete file.

fileSize.description: The total size of the complete file in bytes.

part.description: The sequential part number of this chunk (1-based indexing).

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description: Response DTO returned after successfully adding a workpaper to an engagement binder.

reference.description: The workpaper reference number or code assigned to the newly created workpaper.

description.description: The descriptive name or title of the newly created workpaper.

fileSystemDocumentId.description: The unique identifier for the document in the file storage system.

workpaperId.description: The unique identifier assigned to the newly created workpaper.

allOf.description: Request DTO for adding a new workpaper with file metadata, extending the base workpaper request with file-specific properties.

fileType.description: The MIME type or file extension of the workpaper file (e.g., "application/pdf", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", ".xlsx", ".pdf").

fileSize.description: The size of the workpaper file in bytes.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description: Request DTO for adding a new workpaper with metadata to an engagement binder.

engagementId.description: The unique identifier for the engagement binder where the workpaper will be added.

reference.description: The workpaper reference number or code used for identification.

description.description: The descriptive name or title of the workpaper. This field is required.

assignedLoginId.description: The login identifier of the user assigned to complete this workpaper. Null indicates no assignment.

rollForwardType.description: The roll forward behavior type for future engagement periods. Defaults to "Include" if not specified.

deleteDuringFinalize.description: Indicates whether the workpaper should be deleted during engagement finalization. Null uses default behavior.

folderId.description: The unique identifier for the destination folder within the binder. Null indicates the root level.

documentId.description: The document identifier if linking to an existing document in the file system.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description:
Request DTO for uploading a workpaper file with metadata using multipart/form-data encoding.
Each metadata field is submitted as an individual form field alongside the file.

file.description: The workpaper file to upload. Supported formats include Excel (.xlsx, .xls), Word (.docx, .doc), PDF (.pdf), and other document types.

engagementId.description: The unique identifier for the engagement binder where the workpaper will be added.

reference.description: The workpaper reference number or code used for identification.

description.description: The descriptive name or title of the workpaper. This field is required.

assignedLoginId.description: The login identifier of the user assigned to complete this workpaper. Null indicates no assignment.

rollForwardType.description: The roll forward behavior type for future engagement periods. Defaults to "Include" if not specified.

deleteDuringFinalize.description: Indicates whether the workpaper should be deleted during engagement finalization. Null uses default behavior.

folderId.description: The unique identifier for the destination folder within the binder. Null indicates the root level.

documentId.description: The document identifier if linking to an existing document in the file system.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalE.description: Response wrapper containing the complete hierarchical tree structure of folders and workpapers within an engagement binder.

binderId.description: The unique identifier for the engagement binder.

items.description: Collection of root-level folders and workpapers in the engagement binder's tree structure.

allOf.description: Response DTO representing a single item (folder or workpaper) within an engagement binder's hierarchical tree structure.

documentType.description: The type of document (e.g., "Excel", "Word", "PDF"). Null for folders.

isCheckedOut.description: Indicates whether the workpaper is currently checked out by a user. Null for folders.

isDeleted.description: Indicates whether the item is in the recycle bin (soft deleted). Omitted if false.

isLocked.description: Indicates whether the item is locked for editing. Omitted if false.

isPublished.description: Indicates whether the workpaper has been published. Omitted if false. Null for folders.

items.description: Collection of child items (subfolders and workpapers) nested within this folder. Null if no children exist or if this is a workpaper.

isRecycleBin.description: Indicates whether this folder is the recycle bin. Omitted if false.

statusProperty.description: Detailed status information including checkout, modification, and publication details. Omitted if not applicable.

statusType.description: The status type of the item (e.g., "Available", "CheckedOut"). Omitted if not applicable.

showWarning.description: Indicates whether a warning should be displayed for this item. Omitted if false.

isPlaceholder.description: Indicates whether this item is a placeholder workpaper awaiting content upload.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalE.description: Status information for a workpaper or engagement item including checkout status, modification history, and publication state.

checkedOutUserName.description: Name of the user who has checked out this item. Empty string if the item is not checked out.

checkedOutUserId.description: Unique identifier of the user who has checked out this item. Null if the item is not checked out.

checkedOutDate.description: Date and time when the item was checked out. Null if the item is not checked out.

lastModifiedUserName.description: Name of the user who last modified this item.

lastModifiedDate.description: Date and time when the item was last modified. Null if the item has never been modified.

docStatusType.description: Document status type indicating the current state of the document in GoFileRoom. Possible values: "None", "Indexed", "Printed", "Scanned", "Imported".

publishStatusType.description: Publication status type indicating whether the document is published in GoFileRoom. Possible values: "None", "Indexed", "Printed", "Scanned", "Imported".

isFailed.description: Indicates whether the last operation on this item failed (e.g., upload failure, processing error).

docSecurityNoEdit.description: Indicates whether the document is secured against editing. When true, the document cannot be modified.

isLocked.description: Indicates whether the item is locked for editing by system or administrative restrictions.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsEMEngagem.description: Base class representing an item (folder or document/workpaper) within an engagement binder's hierarchical structure. This class provides common properties for both folders and documents in the binder tree.

id.description: The unique identifier for this binder item (folder or document).

name.description: The display name of the folder or document within the binder hierarchy.

notesCount.description: The number of notes or annotations attached to this item. Used for displaying note indicators in the UI.

parentFolderId.description: The identifier of the parent folder containing this item. Use 0 or -1 for root-level items.

displayOrder.description: The sort order of this item within its parent folder. Lower numbers appear first in the display.

origParentFolderId.description: The original parent folder identifier before any move operations. Used for tracking item history and supporting undo operations.

isFolder.description: Indicates whether this item is a folder (true) or a document/workpaper (false). Used to determine how to render and interact with the item.

description.description: Optional description or notes about this folder or document. Null when not provided.
description.example: Contains all supporting schedules for the tax return

docSecurityNoEdit.description: Optional security flag indicating whether this document is read-only and cannot be edited. True means editing is disabled. Null when not applicable (e.g., for folders).

documentId.description: Optional GoFileRoom document identifier for this item. Only populated for documents/workpapers, not folders. Used for document management operations like checkout, upload, and download.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description: Response containing simplified binder items (folders and workpapers) for move operations

items.description: Hierarchical list of folders and workpapers available for move operations

allOf.description: Represents a folder or workpaper item within an engagement binder for move operations

items.description: Nested child items (subfolders or workpapers) within this folder. Null if this is a workpaper or empty folder.

isRecycleBin.description: Indicates whether this item is the recycle bin folder. Null for regular items.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description: Base class containing common properties for engagement binder items (folders and workpapers)

id.description: The unique identifier for the folder or workpaper

name.description: The name or title of the folder or workpaper

parentFolderId.description: The ID of the parent folder containing this item. 0 for root-level items.

displayOrder.description: The display order/sequence of this item within its parent folder

origParentFolderId.description: The original parent folder ID before any move operations

isFolder.description: Indicates whether this item is a folder (true) or a workpaper (false)

description.description: The description or additional details for the workpaper. Null for folders.

documentId.description: The document identifier for workpapers with associated files. Null for folders or workpapers without files.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description: Response DTO representing a hierarchical folder structure for organizing workpapers within an engagement binder.

name.description: The display name of the folder.

id.description: The unique identifier for this folder.

parentFolderId.description: The identifier of the parent folder. Zero (0) indicates a root-level folder.

items.description: Collection of child folders nested within this folder. Returns null if no child folders exist.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description: Response DTO containing all properties and metadata for a workpaper within an engagement binder.

reference.description: The workpaper reference number or code used for identification.

description.description: The descriptive name or title of the workpaper.

documentType.description: The type of document (e.g., Excel, Word, PDF).

workPaperType.description: The classification of the workpaper type.

reportId.description: The identifier for associated report. Zero indicates no associated report.

fileSystemDocumentId.description: The unique identifier for the document in the file storage system.

fileType.description: The file extension of the workpaper document.

signOffs.description: Collection of sign-off records for review and approval workflow.

staffAssignment.description: The user assigned to complete this workpaper.

binderId.description: The unique identifier for the engagement binder containing this workpaper.

isUploading.description: Indicates whether the workpaper is currently being uploaded.

uploadGuid.description: The unique identifier for tracking the upload process.

isFailed.description: Indicates whether the workpaper upload or processing has failed.

isSmartDocument.description: Indicates whether this is a Smart document integrated with external systems.

isCpeWorkpaper.description: Indicates whether this workpaper is a CPE (Continuing Professional Education) practice aid.

cpeRollforwardOption.description: The CPE roll forward option identifier.

cpePracticeAidId.description: The unique identifier for the CPE practice aid.

isSmartDocumentEnabled.description: Indicates whether Smart document integration is enabled for this workpaper.

nonGfrEngagementItemStatusType.description: The status type for non-GFR (GoFileRoom) engagement items.

fileSourceInfo.description: Information about the source of the file.

placeholderId.description: The identifier for a placeholder workpaper. Zero indicates not a placeholder.

rollForwardType.description: The roll forward behavior type (Include, Exclude, or other options).

deleteDuringFinalize.description: Indicates whether the workpaper should be deleted during engagement finalization.

statusProperty.description: Status information including checkout, modification, and publication details.

clearWarning.description: Indicates whether warnings for this workpaper should be cleared.

clearWarningTimeStamp.description: The timestamp when the warning was cleared.

showWarning.description: Indicates whether a warning should be displayed for this workpaper.

customExcelOptionId.description: The identifier for custom Excel options applied to this workpaper.

jeReference.description: The reference to an associated journal entry.

copySignOff.description: Indicates whether sign-offs should be copied during roll forward operations.

workpaperId.description: The unique identifier for this workpaper.

name.description: The file name of the workpaper document.

notesCount.description: The count of notes or comments attached to this workpaper.

parentFolderId.description: The identifier of the parent folder containing this workpaper.

displayOrder.description: The sort order position within the parent folder.

origParentFolderId.description: The original parent folder identifier before any move operations.

isFolder.description: Indicates whether this item is a folder (true) or a workpaper document (false).

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description: Request DTO for moving workpapers and/or folders to a different location within an engagement binder.

engagementId.description: The unique identifier of the engagement binder containing the items to move.

workpaperIds.description: List of workpaper IDs to move. Can be empty if only moving folders.

displayOrderIndex.description: The display order/position where the items should be placed in the destination folder. 0 indicates the first position.

destFolderId.description: The ID of the destination folder where items should be moved. Null indicates moving to the root level.

folderIds.description: List of folder IDs to move. Can be empty if only moving workpapers.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description: Request DTO for moving one or more workpapers to the recycle bin within an engagement binder.

engagementId.description: The unique identifier for the engagement binder containing the workpapers to move.

workpaperIds.description: List of workpaper identifiers to move to the recycle bin.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description: Request DTO for saving or updating sign-off information for one or more workpapers within an engagement binder.

engagementId.description: The unique identifier for the engagement binder containing the workpapers to sign off.

workpaperIds.description: List of workpaper identifiers to which the sign-off will be applied.

signOff.description: The sign-off information to save, including the sign-off type name and date.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalW.description: DTO representing sign-off data for workpaper review and approval workflow.

name.description: The name or type of the sign-off (e.g., "Prepared", "Reviewed", "Approved").

signedOffDate.description: The date and time when the sign-off was performed. Null indicates the sign-off has not been completed.

clientId.description: Internal system identifier for the client. Unique across the system.

clientName.description: Full name of the client as registered in the system.

number.description: Unique client number/code assigned to the client for reference and organization.

onvioClientId.description: Onvio client identifier for integration with Thomson Reuters Onvio platform. Empty if not integrated.

clients.description: Collection of clients for the current page based on the pagination settings.

totalNumberOfClients.description: Total count of all clients matching the filter criteria across all pages. Use this for pagination controls.

filters.description: Filter criteria for searching clients by name or number. Use wildcards (*) to match any characters.

pagination.description: Pagination settings to control the number of results and page navigation.

showAllClients.description: Determines the source of client data. When true, retrieves all clients from GoFileRoom (GFR). When false, retrieves only clients that have associated engagements/binders in the system.

clientNumber.description: Client number filter. Supports wildcards (*) for partial matching. Use "*" to return all clients.

clientName.description: Client name filter. Supports wildcards (*) for partial matching. Use "*" to return all clients.

pageNumber.description: The page number to retrieve (1-based indexing). First page is 1.

size.description:
Number of results per page. Must be one of the following values: 12, 15, 20, 50, 150, 500, 1000, 10000.
These values correspond to the GfrPageSizeType enum values (XExtraSmall, ExtraSmall, Small, Medium, Large, ExtraLarge, XExtraLarge, XXExtraLarge).

isCreated.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the client was successfully created. Returns true if the client was created, false if the client already exists.

message.description: System-generated message about the operation result. When IsCreated is true, contains the GFR Record ID (e.g., "2595"). When IsCreated is false, contains "The client already exists".

clientName.description: The client name. Must be provided.

clientNumber.description: The client number. Must be provided.

engagementId.description: Unique identifier for the engagement/binder. Use this ID to retrieve engagement details or perform operations.

name.description: Name of the engagement/binder. Null if not set.

isFinalized.description: Indicates whether the engagement has been finalized. Finalized engagements are typically locked from further edits.

period.description: The trial balance period details for this engagement, including start date, end date, and year-end date.

engagementType.description: Type of engagement (e.g., Audit, Review, Tax, Compilation). Null if not specified.

taxSoftwareVendor.description: The tax software vendor used for this engagement (e.g., UltraTax, ProSystem fx, CCH).

periodFrequency.description: Frequency of the engagement period (e.g., Annual, Quarterly, Monthly).

taxEntityType.description: Tax entity type for the engagement (e.g., Corporation, Partnership, Individual). Null if not specified.

engagementStructure.description: Engagement structure type (e.g., Standard, Consolidated, Subsidiary).

priorYearsCount.description: Number of prior year engagements/binders associated with this engagement.

subsidiaryBinderIds.description: List of subsidiary binder IDs if this is a consolidated engagement. Empty if no subsidiaries.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalG.description: Request model for creating or updating grouping code structures within a grouping schedule. Contains the complete hierarchical structure of codes and subcodes used for account classification.

groupingScheduleKey.description: The unique identifier for the grouping schedule. Obtain from GET /external/v1/trialbalance/grouping-schedule/{engagementId}.

description.description: The description of the grouping schedule (e.g., "Standard Balance Sheet", "Cash Basis Classification").

codes.description: List of grouping codes in this schedule. Each code can contain multiple subcodes forming a hierarchical classification structure.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalG.description: Represents a top-level grouping code within a classification schedule. Codes organize accounts into major categories (e.g., Assets, Liabilities, Equity) and can contain subcodes for finer classification.

code.description: The short code identifier (e.g., "A" for Assets, "L" for Liabilities, "E" for Equity). Maximum 15 characters.

groupingCodeKey.description: The unique identifier for this grouping code. Omit when creating new codes; include when updating existing codes.

description.description: The description of this grouping code (e.g., "Assets", "Liabilities", "Equity", "Revenue", "Expenses").

displayIndex.description: Display order index for sorting codes in UI elements and reports. Lower numbers appear first.

subcodes.description: List of subcodes under this code providing finer classification categories (e.g., "Current Assets", "Non-Current Assets" under "Assets").

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalG.description: Represents a subcode within a parent grouping code, providing finer classification within a major category. Subcodes allow for detailed account organization (e.g., "Current Assets" and "Non-Current Assets" within "Assets").

groupingCodeKey.description: The unique identifier of the parent grouping code that this subcode belongs to.

groupingSubcodeKey.description: The unique identifier for this subcode. Omit when creating new subcodes; include when updating existing subcodes.

code.description: The short subcode identifier (e.g., "CA" for Current Assets, "NCA" for Non-Current Assets).

description.description: The description of this subcode (e.g., "Current Assets", "Non-Current Assets", "Current Liabilities").

accountType.description: Optional account type filter for this subcode (e.g., "Asset", "Liability"). Restricts which account types can be assigned to this subcode.

displayIndex.description: Display order index for sorting subcodes within the parent code. Lower numbers appear first.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalT.description: Represents an account grouping schedule configuration for organizing trial balance accounts into financial statement categories and reporting structures.

groupingScheduleKey.description: Unique identifier for the grouping schedule. Use this key to load specific grouping codes and subcodes via other endpoints.

displayIndex.description: Display order for presenting this grouping schedule in user interfaces. Lower numbers appear first.

firmLevel.description: Indicates whether this is a firm-level schedule (true) shared across all engagements, or engagement-specific (false).

description.description: Human-readable description explaining the purpose of this grouping schedule (e.g., "Balance Sheet", "Income Statement", "Tax Return").

disabled.description: Flag indicating whether this grouping schedule is currently disabled and should not be used.

editable.description: Flag indicating whether users can edit the grouping codes and structure within this schedule.

accountGroupingIndex.description: Optional index for account grouping display order within the schedule structure.

codes.description: Collection of grouping codes that define the classification structure for accounts within this schedule.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalT.description: Request model for exporting trial balance account data to Excel or XML format.

engagementId.description: The unique identifier for the engagement whose trial balance data should be exported. Obtain from GET /external/v1/engagements/{clientId}.

viewName.description: The name of the view configuration to use for the export. Obtain from GET /external/v1/trialbalance/views/{engagementId}. The view determines which columns appear in the export.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsAccountAc.description: Request model for deleting one or more trial balance accounts from an engagement.

engagementId.description: The unique identifier for the engagement containing the accounts to delete. Obtain from GET /external/v1/engagements/{clientId}.

accountIds.description: List of account identifiers (AccountKey values) to permanently delete. Obtain AccountKey values from the POST /external/v1/trialbalance/grid-data endpoint. All deletions are permanent and cannot be undone.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsAccountSa.description: Response model returned after successfully creating a new trial balance account.

accountId.description: The unique identifier (AccountKey) assigned to the newly created account. Use this value for subsequent update or delete operations.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalT.description: Base request model for creating a new trial balance account with classification codes, tax codes, and metadata.

engagementId.description: The Id of the Engagement. Must be greater than zero.

accountNumber.description: The account Number. Must be provided.

description.description: The account description. Must be provided.

grpCodeSubcodes.description: List of grouping code and subcode assignments for this account. Grouping codes classify accounts for financial statement preparation.

m3Code.description: The key for the M3 code.

m3Subcode.description: The key for the M3 subcode.

propertyCode.description: Property code for multi-property engagements. Identifies which property this account belongs to.

taxCode.description: The key for the tax code.

taxSubCode.description: The key for the tax code subcode.

tickMarkDescription.description: Tick mark description for audit trail documentation. Describes review or verification steps performed on this account.

wpRef.description: Workpaper reference linking this account to supporting workpapers or documentation.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalT.description: Represents a grouping code and subcode assignment for classifying an account within a specific grouping schedule. Used when creating or updating accounts to specify their financial statement classification.

groupingScheduleKey.description: The grouping schedule key that this code/subcode belongs to. Obtain from GET /external/v1/trialbalance/grouping-schedule/{engagementId}.

codeText.description: The grouping code text (e.g., "A" for Assets, "L" for Liabilities, "E" for Equity).

subcodeText.description: The grouping subcode text for finer classification within the code (e.g., "CA" for Current Assets, "NCA" for Non-Current Assets).

allOf.description: Request model for updating an existing trial balance account, including all account properties, classifications, and balances. Inherits base account properties from AccountBaseExternalDto.

viewConfigId.description: The view configuration key used for this update operation. Obtain from GET /external/v1/trialbalance/views/{engagementId}.

accountKey.description: The unique identifier (AccountKey) of the account to update. Obtain from POST /external/v1/trialbalance/grid-data.

balances.description: List of balance updates for different periods. Each entry specifies a period and the new balance amount.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalT.description: Represents a balance update for a specific trial balance period. Used when updating account balances to specify the period, amount, and balance type.

tbPerKey.description: The trial balance period key identifying which period this balance applies to. Obtain from GET /external/v1/trialbalance/periods/{engagementId}.

amount.description: The balance amount. Positive values typically represent debits for asset and expense accounts, credits for liability, equity, and revenue accounts.

EMMainDataTransferObjectsModelsExternalE.description:
Represents an engagement binder containing all properties related to its lifecycle,
finalization state, engagement structure, external system integrations, and processing flags.

engagementBinderId.description: The unique identifier of the engagement binder.

name.description: The display name of the engagement binder.

engagementType.description: The type of engagement (e.g., Audit, Tax).

subsidiaryBinderIds.description: The list of binder IDs representing subsidiary binders in a consolidated engagement.

periodFrequency.description: The frequency of the trial balance period (e.g., Annual, Monthly, Quarterly).

period.description: The trial balance period associated with the binder.

priorYearsCount.description: The number of prior years to include in the binder.

clientId.description: The unique identifier of the client associated with this binder.

isFinalized.description: Indicates whether the overall engagement binder has been finalized.

isTrialBalanceFinalized.description: Indicates whether the trial balance portion of the engagement has been finalized.

isWorkpapersFinalized.description: Indicates whether the workpapers portion of the engagement has been finalized.

isJournalEntriesFinalized.description: Indicates whether the journal entries portion of the engagement has been finalized.

isNotesListFinalized.description: Indicates whether the notes list portion of the engagement has been finalized.

engagementBeginDate.description: The start date of the engagement period.

engagementEndDate.description: The end date of the engagement period.

reportReleaseDate.description: The date the engagement report is scheduled for release.

documentDuration.description: The number of months after which documents are considered complete and eligible for archival.

documentCompletionDate.description: The calculated date by which document completion is expected.

completionCalculatedFrom.description: The engagement date field used to calculate the document completion date.

engagementStructure.description: The structural type of the engagement (e.g., None, Consolidated, Divisional, FundGroup).

structureMask.description: The mask pattern that defines the division or fund grouping structure for the binder.

hasCptLinks.description: Indicates whether the binder has active CPT (Checkpoint Tools) integration links.

cptIntegrationData.description: Serialized JSON data containing CPT integration configuration details.

hasSmartEngagementLinks.description: Indicates whether the binder is linked to an Onvio Smart engagement.

smartIntegrationData.description: Serialized JSON data containing Onvio Smart integration configuration details.

smartBinderId.description: The unique identifier of the linked Onvio Smart binder.

smartRollForwardType.description: The Smart engagement type to apply when this binder is rolled forward.

taxEntityType.description: The tax entity type associated with the engagement (e.g., Individual, Corporation, Partnership).

taxSoftwareVendor.description: The tax software vendor used in conjunction with this engagement.

taxEntityDescription.description: The human-readable description of the tax entity type for display purposes.
